visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing black cat-ear accessories, a shiny silver halter top, and a short black pleated skirt, stands in an indoor hallway featuring marble-like walls and an elevator. She smiles warmly at the camera, swaying her hips and arms in a light dance movement while looking directly at the lens. (2) As the music picks up, she flexes her biceps playfully while laughing. A second woman, wearing a sparkling silver sequined top, grey shrug, and silver shorts, suddenly appears from behind her, grabbing her waist in a friendly manner. The background lighting is warm from a chandelier above, casting soft shadows. (3) Both women engage in a synchronized, energetic dance routine. They make hand gestures, mimic cat-like paws, and laugh frequently. The camera remains mostly static at eye-level, capturing their full-body movements against the lobby backdrop which includes ornate golden frames and elevator displays. (4) They lean in closer to the camera, laughing uncontrollably. The first woman points at the second woman's outfit, specifically the sequined fringe, highlighting its texture. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of their clothing and joyful facial expressions before they finish the routine.
